name: wild-bunch-project-pack
description: Self-contained Wild Bunch project guidance and bundled marketplace skills for safe Codex worker execution.
rights: First-party Harley-authored Wild Bunch project guidance plus bundled copies of selected marketplace skills. Copied marketplace assets remain under their source plugin licenses and are documented in the pack provenance map.

interface.shortDescription: Self-contained Wild Bunch project guidance for Codex workers
interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin bundle that packages the Wild Bunch project doctrine, domain model guidance, .NET architecture guardrails, browser-game stack guidance, worker verification rules, and bundled copies of the relevant marketplace skills into one installable pack.
defaultPrompt: Use the Wild Bunch Project Pack to inspect project posture before making changes.
Compare the requested work against the Wild Bunch doctrine, domain, architecture, browser-game, and verification rules.
Use the bundled marketplace skills in this pack instead of depending on other plugins being present.
Report any scope gaps before editing source.
